why_no_new_terms: A drafting manual: most of its 542 candidates are its own method — templates, checks, hard rules, genre modes, lock labels, repository layout (§9–§13). Its world vocabulary (§1–§8) lands on pages that exist. What it names without a page is either a sub-location with no chapter anchor or function beyond one table cell (Transitkorridor Delta-7, Wald des Flüsterns, Ozean-Becken, Zitadelle, Wartungsschächte, Die unbewachten Tore, Quelle des Flüsterns, Unkartiertes Territorium), a narrative device (the five strands, the Genesis motifs, the anchors, Ouroboros, Reveal-Disziplin), a restated lock whose source is another document, or a name the wiki has already declined (Wir-AEGIS-plural, J47/J73; Komponente 734; Erasure-Pol, J59). The rule of document 11 — a canonical sub-location with a chapter anchor — admits Transitkorridor Delta-7 („Kap 1 ff.", L103) and the Archivar-Klasse-II-Arbeitsraum (L105); both are one table row, Kael's routine and his post, and were left as not_promoted rather than opened from one row.
